name: onboarding_sdk
_comment_requires: onboarding_sdk >= 1.2.1 requires base_sdk >= 1.66.6 (the brightness-taking AppStyle colour-role helpers every step of first-run setup now resolves its mode through instead of the app-wide AppStyle.isDark static: inkFor, secondaryInkFor, surfaceFor, cardFor, cardAltFor and strokeFor). onboarding_sdk >= 1.2.0 requires base_sdk >= 1.59.0 (LocalStorage.setOnboardingRun/getOnboardingRun/deleteOnboardingRun over the generic setJson/getJson/deleteJson key API, design 46e); the composer manifest schema has no machine-readable minimum-version field, so this is the declaration. The default OnboardingProgressStore persists the first-run setup record through those accessors and moves a 1.1.0 record from its old private key (onboarding.run) across on first read.
_comment_embedded_widgets: EmbeddedWidgets.I.introPage(): auth_sdk's LoginPage shows the intro carousel via this indirection so it never imports onboarding_sdk directly (ADR-005). OnboardingIntroRouteView lives in the installed shell template above (templates/routes/onboarding_route_pages.dart -> lib/presentation/routes/onboarding_route_pages.dart), hence the ${package} import — every consuming app gets the same file at the same path.
_comment: The installed shell template (templates/routes/onboarding_route_pages.dart) carries the @generated-onboarding-slides / @generated-onboarding-imports marker blocks that sdk_installer_base.py's update_onboarding_slides() fills from every installed SDK's own manifest 'onboarding_slides' list, plus an @onboarding-complete-hook placeholder for manifest 'integrations' to extend completion routing. database section removed 2026-07-13: it declared OnboardingStatesTable, which is not defined anywhere in this SDK's lib (phantom from the pre-refork era). Re-add together with a real drift_tables.dart when onboarding gets offline state.
